what.text: This page follows refugees from Russia living in France, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 36737 Russian refugees in France, 37.0% of all refugees from Russia.
France is the largest host of Russian refugees, followed by Germany, the United States and Austria.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Chechnya territory in Russia from 1994 to 1996 and from 1999 to 2007, with the Chechen Republic of Ichkeria, at war level in some years.
It also records an interstate armed conflict between Russia and Ukraine from 2022 to 2025, and armed conflict over the government of Russia with LSR, RDK and Wagner in 2023 and 2024.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1995 at 1180 refugees.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2021 to 2025, and the figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in France.
These are year-end totals for France only, reported to UNHCR.
